title: Memory Foam in Pieces Pillow; nice pillow; lovely pillowcases
text:
Memory Foam in Pieces Pillow; nice pillow; lovely pillowcases. I ordered the small square pillow. It comes with one extra pillowcase besides the one that is on the pillow. The pillowcases are quilted and relativelhy soft and thick. I do like the ear hole as it helps a little when resting on my left side. I particularly love this when resting the back of my head in the hole of the pillow. It is actually very comfortable.

The disappointment came when I opened the pillowcase. The entire pillow is composed of hundreds of memory foam pieces left over from the manufacturing process. It is contained via a thin mesh type cloth similar to what food store reusable shopping bags are made of. This means that if it rips, memory foam will be all over the interior pillowcase and the pillowcase cannot be changed. In addition, about 14 years ago I paid over $80 for two pillows that I thought were solid memory foam and wound up throwing them out after several weeks because the composition shifted making the pillows useless.

I am not saying this will happen with this pillow. However, be aware that this is NOT a solid memory foam pillow. It is made of memory foam pieces.

Despite this, I still like this pillow. Only time will tell if it will last. The current price of $38.89 is on the high side for this considering it is made of what I consider "memory foam waste."
